variantNote: South African Sesotho spelling used (Pherekgong, with kg). Lesotho orthography writes January as Phesekgong/Pherekong and some others slightly differently (e.g. Hlakubele, Mmesa, Phupu are shared).
note: Machine draft from knowledge, not fluent-speaker approved. Month names are the standard Sesotho set. Short forms are not an established convention; I used the first letters, with Hlk/Hlb and Php/Phu chosen to keep them distinct.
